messages.text: How Glasner turned McAtee into his new Wharton

metadata.summary: When Oliver Glasner moved to Nottingham Forest after departing Crystal Palace, he tasked himself with replicating the 3-4-2-1 system that worked so well at Selhurst Park.
metadata.content: James McAtee: How Oliver Glasner has transformed Nottingham Forest midfielder from forgotten man to his new Adam Wharton | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis James McAtee: How Oliver Glasner has transformed Nottingham Forest midfielder from forgotten man to his new Adam Wharton James McAtee has been one of the most creative players at the start of this Premier League season; Oliver Glasner has turned McAtee into his new Adam Wharton at Forest; watch Crystal Palace vs Nottingham Forest live on Sky Sports' Super Sunday from 1pm, kick-off 2pm Sam Blitz Football Journalist @SamBIitz Tuesday 6 October 2026 13:04, UK Image: James McAtee has become Oliver Glasner's new version of Adam Wharton at Nottingham Forest When Oliver Glasner moved to Nottingham Forest after departing Crystal Palace, he tasked himself with replicating the 3-4-2-1 system that worked so well at Selhurst Park. A key part of that set-up are the two central midfielders. "We call them the quarterbacks," said Glasner last season and at Palace. The Austrian had the perfect quarterback in Adam Wharton. Defensively astute but also influential and creative in attack. As well as finding the Forest version of Wharton, he also had to replace the Man City-bound Elliot Anderson - heartbeat of the team - in that same area of the pitch. Wednesday 7 October 2026 16:09, UK Image: Chepstow hosts action on Saturday We have a busy day’s racing on Friday with jumps action from Chepstow, live on Sky Sports Racing... 3.43 Chepstow - Cosmic Connection and Lord Byron headline Grade Two cracker A deep renewal of the feature Grade Two DragonBet Persian War Novices' Hurdle at Chepstow where progressive duo Cosmic Connection and Lord Bryon clash. The Chris Gordon-trained Cosmic Connection arrives having won three of his four outings over hurdles, dominating the Novices' Championship Final at Sandown when last seen in April. He steps up in grade and distance but rates a fine prospect for the campaign ahead. Lord Bryon enjoyed a cracking novice season finishing fifth in the Triumph Hurdle at Cheltenham before claiming fourth at Aintree. He bettered those efforts when chasing home King Rasko Grey at Punchestown and fitness will not be an issue having had a pipe opener on the flat last month. metadata.summary: Bucky Irving and rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels starred as the previously winless Tampa Bay Buccaneers secured a shock 24-16 road win over the Dallas Cowboys on on Thursday night.
metadata.content: Dallas Cowboys suffer shock loss to Tampa Bay Buccaneers as Bucky Irving and rookie QB Jalon Daniels impress | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Dallas Cowboys suffer shock loss to Tampa Bay Buccaneers as Bucky Irving and rookie QB Jalon Daniels impress Bucky Irving ran for a career-high 165 yards and two touchdowns in the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' 24-16 road win over the Dallas Cowboys on Thursday night; undrafted rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels threw for 189 yards and one TD, while Dak Prescott tossed two picks for the Cowboys Friday 9 October 2026 06:57, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Dallas Cowboys from Week 5 of the NFL season Bucky Irving and rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels starred as the previously winless Tampa Bay Buccaneers secured a shock 24-16 road win over the Dallas Cowboys on on Thursday night. Irving ran for a career-high 165 yards, including a 72-yard run that set up Tampa Bay's go-ahead touchdown, while Irving himself twice found the end zone. Daniels tossed one of those TDs to Irving in the first half while directing a turnover-free offense amid several Dallas miscues in what was only the undrafted rookie's second NFL start.
